email.body:
Port report, Santos, 22 Jan 2025.

Crane No. 1 failed at 1030 UTC with an electrical fault in the slewing motor. Loading at hold 1 stopped; repaired by ship's electrician, crane back at work 1650 UTC.

Master MV CALDER SOUND

summary: Voyage Agent reports: The Master reports that Crane No. 1 failed from 1030 UTC to 1650 UTC on 22 January 2025, with one crane out of use. According to the simulated hire statement, the total owner's account is 791.67 US...

result.result:
The Master reports that Crane No. 1 failed from 1030 UTC to 1650 UTC on 22 January 2025, with one crane out of use. According to the simulated hire statement, the total owner's account is 791.67 USD (hire deducted 791.67 USD, bunkers 0 USD) for 6.33 hours. Based on the CP terms' off-hire clause and rider, the breakdown stopped loading at hold 1, and the ship is off hire pro rata for the time lost.

The operator should decide whether to put the ship off hire pro rata and notify the owner. If agreed, this would involve: (a) a voyage management system entry for the off-hire period with the cranes out of use, and (b) an e-mail to the owner's vessel technical management giving the period, the crane and the reason.

I recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.
